bike.parquet.source: UCI Bike Sharing Dataset, daily file (Fanaee-T and Gama, 2013), CC BY 4.0
bike.parquet.cleaning: categorical codes decoded; weather columns rescaled to C, % and km/h

retail.parquet.source: UCI Online Retail II (Chen, 2019), CC BY 4.0
retail.parquet.origin: copied from challenges/Data Analytics/Customer Segmentation Explorer (RFM Analysis)/sample_data: every line of 600 random customers; revenue is derived at load

ames.parquet.source: Ames, Iowa housing (De Cock, 2011) via R modeldata::ames (Rdatasets)
ames.parquet.cleaning: 16 of 74 columns kept; sale_month built from Year_Sold and Mo_Sold
